domain_comparison: grids three and four have identical spatial spacing 0.0075 and time spacing 1/1024; only the state domain changes

boundary_data: affine far-state values for limiting production +/-coupling, as defined in scalar_baseline.asymptotic_boundaries; finite-domain approximations, not true unbounded boundary values
deployed_policy: save every time-state action node; bilinear interpolation inside the grid, analytic schedule outside, followed by the declared primitive-box or schedule-tube clipping
